pages.text: Your first farming drone needs iron, copper, redstone, a little gold and $(l)aluminum$(). Here is the whole path; $(l:materials/materials)Materials and Progression$(/l) shows where it leads.
The $(l)CyberFarm$() tab of the advancements screen (press L) shows where to go next: drones, power, and nuclear power up to the mech.

Every drone is built around a $(item)Drone Core$(), and every machine and module around a $(l:materials/circuits)Basic Circuit$(/l): craft your first ones by hand. Frames also need $(item)Rotor$()s and a $(item)Battery Cell$().
pages.title: 1. Craft the components

pages.text: Place a $(l:generators/combustion_generator)Combustion Generator$(/l) and feed it coal or any other furnace fuel. It pushes FE into every machine touching it, or into $(l:cables/energy_conduit)Energy Conduit$(/l)s that carry it further.$(br2)$(l)Look at any CyberFarm machine$() to see a small panel beside the crosshair: whether it is working, the FE it makes or
pages.title: 2. Make power

pages.text: uses each tick, how full its energy buffer is and how far its batch has got. Working machines also show it: their front lights up and moves, their lights glow in the dark, and they give off sparks, smoke, frost or bubbles depending on the machine.

Drone frames are made of aluminum. Mine $(l)Bauxite Ore$(), smelt the Raw Bauxite into Alumina and put it in an $(l:materials/aluminum)Electrolyzer$(/l) next to the generator: it makes $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum Ingot$(/l)s (see $(l:materials/aluminum)Aluminum$(/l)). A $(l:materials/circuits)Fabricator$(/l) beside it makes Basic Circuits two at a time.
pages.title: 3. Make aluminum

pages.text: Place a $(l:drone_systems/drone_assembler)Drone Assembler$(/l) next to the generator. Put a $(l:drone_systems/drone_frames)Basic Drone Frame$(/l) and a $(l:drone_systems/modules)Harvester Module$(/l) inside, then press $(l)Assemble$().
pages.title: 4. Build the drone

pages.text: Place a $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Drone Dock$(/l) in the middle of your farm, also next to a power source (or connect it with cables from another mod). Right-click the dock with the drone to deploy it.
pages.title: 5. Give it a home

pages.text: By default the drone works a $(l)9x9$() area centred on the dock. Use the $(l:drone_systems/drone_dock)Survey Tool$(/l) to choose a different area: $(l)sneak + scroll$() (or right-click the air) to its $(l)Area$() mode, click the dock, then two opposite corners. The tool tells you each step above the hotbar.
The drone brings everything back to the dock. Open the dock to take the items, or pull them out with a hopper or any item pipe.
